basics.name: Punrong Rany
basics.summary:
AI researcher, software engineer, and technology project manager with 6+ years of experience across artificial intelligence, digital banking, telecommunications, and entrepreneurship.

Currently pursuing an MSc in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Calgary, conducting research on deep learning applications in power systems and energy under the supervision of Dr. Christine Cao and Dr. Samira Ebrahimi Kahou.

Previously managed digital banking initiatives at Canadia Bank, contributed to software development at Smart Axiata and Phillip Bank, and co-founded an education technology platform that helped 1,000+ students explore scholarship opportunities.

work.summary: Conducting research on applied machine learning for energy systems, focusing on optimization, planning, and policymaking under the supervision of Dr. Christine Cao and Dr. Samira Ebrahimi Kahou.
highlights: Exploring deep learning applications for power systems and energy.
Investigating machine learning approaches to complex energy system problems.
Collaborating with researchers on AI-driven energy research.

work.summary: Managed large-scale technology initiatives across mobile banking, core banking, AI, and cloud solutions, coordinating project delivery and issue resolution for a digital banking ecosystem serving more than 2 million users.
highlights: Led more than five major technology initiatives across banking and digital services.
Coordinated testing and cross-platform incident resolution to support reliable product releases.
Managed mobile banking activities involving more than 4,000 test cases.

work.summary: Conducted research using natural language processing to analyze graduate career trajectories and generate insights for university admissions and career counseling strategies.
highlights: Developed an NLP model to analyze career trajectories among approximately 150 graduates annually.
Generated insights covering more than 20 job types and 10 industries.
Explored how employment trends could inform admissions and career counseling.

work.company: សិស្សច្បង ~ Sers Chborng (The Mentor), Cambodia
work.summary: Co-founded an education and scholarship mentorship initiative in Cambodia, leading technology development and business strategy to help students access higher education and scholarship opportunities.
highlights: Supported approximately 1,000 students through mentorship and educational webinars.
Secured USD 4,000 in investment from Smart Axiata.
Led the development of the website and mobile application.

work.summary: Supported business process improvement, software testing, and marketing initiatives, contributing to system upgrades and business strategy development.
highlights: Conducted user acceptance testing for the Interpreter Management System 3.0 upgrade.
Executed more than 20 test cases to support software quality assurance.
Conducted market research and competitive analysis.
Produced three promotional business strategy videos.

work.summary: Developed and maintained web-based solutions for a banking environment, contributing to the bank's website and insurance system while supporting software quality and production stability.
highlights: Built the bank's website for an institution serving more than 1 million customers.
Developed more than 50 features for the insurance system.
Resolved critical and high-priority issues within four hours of identification.

work.summary: Contributed to telecommunications software development by enhancing broadband systems and building APIs for mobile service management applications.
highlights: Delivered more than 30 features for the Fixed Wired Broadband System.
Developed more than 20 APIs for the SmartNas mobile application.
Contributed to digital services supporting millions of telecommunications users.

work.company: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology, South Korea
work.summary: Conducted machine learning research on vehicle detection using Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD), exploring custom inputs and presenting research findings during an international research internship.
highlights: Investigated deep learning-based vehicle detection using SSD.
Explored custom inputs for vehicle detection.
Presented research findings from the internship project.
